posts.title: Facebook Knows My GPU: Inside My Data Export
posts.description: I stopped posting in 2019. Businesses kept reporting activity. My download contains 432 reports about activity on other websites and apps , from 28 businesses. Every report is dated 2024 or later. My feed posts stopped in 2019; businesses reported activity in 2024, 2025 and 2026. Two annual bar charts share the same calendar and count scale. posts.description: For the past decade I’ve been running some form of a home lab.
